name: Do nothing
description: Keep the current inventory policy; no mitigation spend.

name: Worst-supplier first
description: Spend the budget on suppliers with the highest historical late rate.

name: Lowest-cover first
description: Spend the budget on components with the fewest weeks of inventory.

name: Deterministic LP
description: Optimize against one average scenario (mean delays).

name: Stochastic LP
description: Optimize the expected outcome across sampled scenarios.

name: Stochastic LP + CVaR
description: Stochastic LP that also penalizes the worst 10% of scenarios.

name: Oracle (perfect foresight)
description: Same constraints, but knows the realized scenario. Upper bound.
